messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Multiple model bootstrap failures detected for model 'redwood-mpt-7b-v1' in us-west-2. Symptoms: CUDA OOM during deserialize, and repeated JIT compile timeouts. Pager: Ryan. Priority: P1

Ryan: I'm on it. Seeing 5 distinct pods failing to complete model load within last 2m. Errors show both `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` and "failed to unmarshal weights: checksum mismatch". First investigating node memory pressure.

Marta: tagging in. @Ryan can you paste the tail of a failing pod log? I want the exact stack.

Ryan: paste below
```text
[2026-03-15T10:12:04Z] ERROR model_loader: load failed for model redwood-mpt-7b-v1 pod redwood-7b-1: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory
[2026-03-15T10:12:04Z] WARN serializer: deserialization error: failed to unmarshal weights: expected 1048576 bytes, got 0
[2026-03-15T10:12:06Z] ERROR jit_compiler: compile timed out after 120000ms
```

Izzie: looks like two separate failure modes: allocator OOM and a corrupted artifact / partial download. Could be repeated restarts hitting download race. Any artifact store errors?

Ryan: artifact service shows some 5xxs around same window, likely transient S3 throttling. Also kernel compile seems to hang when memory is tight.

Marta: immediate mitigations: 1) Pause warmup autoscaler to stop concurrent warmups. 2) Disable aggressive parallel model downloads (set `max_parallel_artifact_fetch=1`). 3) Route traffic away from us-west-2 affected pool to other healthy pools. 4) Switch traffic for critical customer bundles to quantized fallback.

Priya: I've prepared a routing policy change. Can apply quick patch to route requests for dedicated customers C-001 and C-004 to us-east-1 fallback model `redwood-mpt-7b-quantized`.

Ryan: Go ahead. I'll run the node triage and clear any stuck compile caches.

Marta: Commands I'm running now:
```bash
# stop warmup controller
kubectl scale deployment warmup-controller -n inference --replicas=0
# limit warmup concurrency
kubectl patch cm inference-config -p '{"data":{"max_concurrent_warmups":"2"}}'
# flush compile cache on build nodes
redis-cli -h compile-cache us-east-1 flushdb
```

Izzie: Also increasing per-container memory limit for model loader on affected nodes to 200Gi temporarily to avoid OOM during recoveries. Watch side effects on node scheduling.

Ryan: I ran `nvidia-smi` on node gpu-3 and free memory was ~400Mi during failure -> indicates fragmentation; will restart driver on that node.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing policy patch -> canary 1/4 -> status: success

Priya: Routing change applied and canary passed. Now promoted to 100% for targeted customers. Monitoring latency and error rate.

Amy: CS loop: I've messaged C-001 and told them we have a transient model load issue and that we've rerouted to a quantized fallback. They'll hold until we confirm no functional regressions. I'll keep them updated.

Marta: Observability note: enabling debug logging for model loader to capture artifact checksum mismatches, but log throttle on to avoid noise.

Izzie: Found one reproducible artifact corruption: S3 multipart upload left zero-length part -> deserialization got 0 bytes. Artifact team notified. Workaround: redownload artifacts from replica bucket and rehydrate cache.

Ryan: manual rehydrate done on two nodes. Re-triggered warmup with limited concurrency, both completed successfully for quantized variant.

Marta: Still seeing a few compile timeouts on older kernels. As temporary, we set `jit_compile_timeout_ms` to 300000 (5m). This will increase recovery time but prevent spurious aborts while we rebuild compile cache.

Izzie: Starting a dedicated background job to precompile kernels on a cold pool (no customer traffic) to seed compile-cache. ETA ~15m.

Priya: Any customer impact summary so far?

Amy: Impact: C-001 experienced ~30% increase in latency during the routing change window, no errors; C-004 had brief 500s for ~90s before routing applied. Public status page updated: "Degraded performance for select customers; mitigation in progress." Keep wording conservative.

Ryan: Handing off to Marta for next 2 hours for stabilization. I'm available if anything spikes.

Marta: Acknowledge. I'll run the warmup runbook and follow up. Next steps captured in the incident doc. Please add any remaining log excerpts here. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-2333334444. Incident P1 active. Ops timeline must be updated within 30m.

Izzie: Will follow up when compile-cache job completes and once artifact team confirms the root cause fix on S3 side.

Amy: I'll send a brief CS update after stabilization. Thanks all.

Marta: Closing note: rollback knobs we used - routing policy, warmup concurrency, jit timeout, temp memory bump. We'll revert to normal once compile-cache seeded and artifact integrity confirmed.

Ryan: Marking last check at 2333334678 - all critical customers on fallback, no active OOMs on affected pool. Over to postmortem.
